proofs.proof_tex:
By \(\text{thm:sc-ctfid-output-soundness}\), every returned circuit used here is a rational function of the supplied regime probabilities on its verified domain.  Let \(m_r\) be the finite number of cells in regime \(r\), regard \(p_r\) and \(\widehat p_r\) as vectors in \(\mathbb R^{m_r}\), and concatenate the regime blocks.  By \(\text{ass:circuit-margin}\), every one of the finitely many circuit divisors has absolute value at least \(\varepsilon\) at \(p\).  Continuity gives an open neighborhood \(U\) of \(p\) on which all those divisors have absolute value at least \(\varepsilon/2\).  Each \(C_j\) is therefore twice continuously differentiable on \(U\); after shrinking \(U\) to a bounded neighborhood, the finitely many first and second derivatives are bounded there.

Write \(a_n=\max_{r\in\mathcal R}|n_r/n-\rho_r|\), so that \(\delta_n=n^{-1/2}+a_n\).  By \(\text{ass:positive-regime-fractions}\), there is \(c>0\) such that \(n_r/n\ge c\) for all regimes and all sufficiently large \(n\).  Under \(\text{ass:independent-regime-sampling}\),
\[
E\lVert\widehat p-p\rVert^2
=\sum_{r\in\mathcal R}\frac{1-\lVert p_r\rVert^2}{n_r}
\le \sum_{r\in\mathcal R}\frac{1}{n_r}
=O(n^{-1}).
\]
Consequently \(\widehat p-p=O_P(n^{-1/2})\) and \(P(\widehat p\in U)\to1\).  Taylor expansion on this event, with the bounded Hessian just established, gives
\[
\sqrt n(\widehat Q-Q)
=\sum_{r\in\mathcal R}J_{Q,r}(p)\sqrt n(\widehat p_r-p_r)+o_P(1).
\]
For each fixed regime,
\[
\sqrt n(\widehat p_r-p_r)
=\frac{1}{\sqrt n}\sum_{i=1}^{n_r}\frac{n}{n_r}(e_{X_{ri}}-p_r).
\]
Because \(n/n_r\to\rho_r^{-1}\) and \(n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^{n_r}(e_{X_{ri}}-p_r)=O_P(1)\), replacing \(n/n_r\) by \(\rho_r^{-1}\) changes the display by \(o_P(1)\).  There are only finitely many regimes.  Substitution therefore proves the asserted asymptotic linear representation
\[
\sqrt n(\widehat Q-Q)
=\frac{1}{\sqrt n}\sum_{r\in\mathcal R}\sum_{i=1}^{n_r}
\rho_r^{-1}J_{Q,r}(p)(e_{X_{ri}}-p_r)+o_P(1)
=\frac{1}{\sqrt n}\sum_{r,i}\varphi_r(X_{ri})+o_P(1).
\]

We verify the joint limit directly, including the singular case.  For any fixed \(b\in\mathbb R^d\), put
\[
Y_{ri}=b^{\mathsf T}\rho_r^{-1}J_{Q,r}(p)(e_{X_{ri}}-p_r).
\]
These variables are independent and centered, and, because every alphabet and the regime menu are fixed, they are uniformly bounded.  Uniform third-order expansion yields
\[
E\exp\{itY_{ri}/\sqrt n\}
=1-\frac{t^2E(Y_{ri}^2)}{2n}+O(n^{-3/2}),
\]
where the remainder is uniform in \(r,i\).  Summing the logarithms over \(\sum_r n_r=n\) observations gives
\[
\log E\exp\!\left\{\frac{it}{\sqrt n}\sum_{r,i}Y_{ri}\right\}
\longrightarrow -\frac{t^2}{2}\,b^{\mathsf T}\Sigma_Qb,
\]
because \(n_r/n\to\rho_r\) and
\[
\frac1n\sum_{r,i}E(Y_{ri}^2)
\longrightarrow
b^{\mathsf T}J_Q(p)\operatorname{blockdiag}_{r\in\mathcal R}
\left\{\rho_r^{-1}\bigl(\operatorname{diag}(p_r)-p_rp_r^{\mathsf T}\bigr)\right\}
J_Q(p)^{\mathsf T}b.
\]
The right-hand side is \(b^{\mathsf T}\Sigma_Qb\).  Fourier inversion after convolution with an arbitrarily small nonsingular Gaussian shows from the displayed characteristic-function convergence that every contrast converges to its centered Gaussian law; letting the convolution variance decrease to zero gives the possibly degenerate limit.  Applying this simultaneously to the joint characteristic function proves
\[
\sqrt n(\widehat Q-Q)\ \rightsquigarrow\ N(0,\Sigma_Q).
\]

It remains to justify covariance estimation and the random threshold.  On \(U\), bounded second derivatives imply
\[
\lVert J_Q(\widehat p)-J_Q(p)\rVert=O_P(n^{-1/2}).
\]
The map \(u\mapsto\operatorname{diag}(u)-uu^{\mathsf T}\) is Lipschitz on each finite simplex.  Moreover, because both \(n_r/n\) and \(\rho_r\) are eventually bounded below by a positive constant,
\[
\left|\frac{n}{n_r}-\frac1{\rho_r}\right|
\le C\left|\frac{n_r}{n}-\rho_r\right|
\]
for one finite \(C\) and all sufficiently large \(n\).  Expanding the finite matrix products in the covariance formula therefore gives the coordinate-uniform bound
\[
\lVert\widehat\Sigma_Q-\Sigma_Q\rVert
=O_P(n^{-1/2}+a_n)=O_P(\delta_n).
\]
The threshold condition in \(\text{def:simultaneous-region}\) is explicit: \(\kappa_n\to0\) and \(\delta_n/\kappa_n\to0\).  Hence
\[
\lVert\widehat\Sigma_Q-\Sigma_Q\rVert=o_P(\kappa_n).
\]
Indeed, tightness of the preceding norm divided by \(\delta_n\), multiplied by the deterministic factor \(\delta_n/\kappa_n\to0\), proves the last display.  This supplies the covariance-estimation rate required by the threshold rather than assuming it.

Let \(I_0=\{j:\Sigma_{Q,jj}>0\}\).  If \(j\in I_0\), covariance consistency and \(\kappa_n\to0\) imply \(P(\widehat\Sigma_{Q,jj}>\kappa_n)\to1\).  If \(j\notin I_0\), positive semidefiniteness gives \(\widehat\Sigma_{Q,jj}\ge0\), and the \(o_P(\kappa_n)\) bound gives
\[
P\{\widehat\Sigma_{Q,jj}>\kappa_n\}
\le P\{\lVert\widehat\Sigma_Q-\Sigma_Q\rVert>\kappa_n\}\longrightarrow0.
\]
Symbolically constant coordinates are excluded by definition and have zero diagonal variance.  A finite union bound over \(j=1,\ldots,d\) proves
\[
P(\widehat I_+=I_0)\longrightarrow1.
\]

Suppose \(I_0\ne\varnothing\).  On the event \(\widehat I_+=I_0\), covariance consistency implies convergence of the selected covariance matrix and of all its positive diagonal entries.  Couple the population and plug-in Gaussian vectors as \(Z=\Sigma_{Q,I_0,I_0}^{1/2}G\) and \(\widehat Z=\widehat\Sigma_{Q,I_0,I_0}^{1/2}G\) for one standard Gaussian \(G\).  Continuity of the positive-semidefinite square root gives \(\widehat Z\to Z\) in probability.  Therefore the plug-in law of
\[
\max_{j\in I_0}\frac{|\widehat Z_j|}{\sqrt{\widehat\Sigma_{Q,jj}}}
\]
converges to that of \(T=\max_{j\in I_0}|Z_j|/\sqrt{\Sigma_{Q,jj}}\).  The Gaussian law has a positive density on its linear support, and the boundary of each max-norm ball has Lebesgue measure zero in that support; hence \(T\) has a continuous distribution.  Scaling a nonzero support neighborhood also shows that its distribution function is strictly increasing on its nontrivial range.  Thus the plug-in \((1-\alpha)\)-quantile converges to the population quantile.  The joint Gaussian limit, Slutsky's argument for the consistent diagonal standardizers, and \(P(\widehat I_+=I_0)\to1\) now yield
\[
P\!\left(
|\widehat Q_j-Q_j|\le c_{1-\alpha}\sqrt{\widehat\Sigma_{Q,jj}/n}
\text{ for every }j\in I_0
\right)\longrightarrow1-\alpha.
\]

If a circuit simplifies symbolically to a constant, its plug-in value equals that constant whenever the circuit is evaluated, so reporting it as an exact equality is valid.  Every other coordinate excluded with probability tending to one has \(\Sigma_{Q,jj}=0\); the proved selection result therefore justifies labeling it first-order degenerate and withholding a Wald interval.  This completes all claims, including consistency, singular Gaussian limits, threshold selection, and simultaneous coverage.

added_lemmas.statement: In the recursive finite-SCM setting with an acyclic causal diagram, an unnested counterfactual probability is identifiable from a specified collection of observational and experimental distributions if and only if \(\mathsf{ctfID}\) returns an expression for it.

source.locator: Theorem 5 (\(\mathsf{ctfID}\) completeness), arXiv:2107.03190v2, source file main.tex, lines 613--615
source.verbatim_statement: A counterfactual probability \(P(\mathbf Y_*=\mathbf y_*)\) is identifiable from \(\mathbf Z\) and \(\mathcal G\) if and only if \(\mathsf{ctfID}\) returns an expression for it.

attestation.note: Transcribed from Theorem 5 in the arXiv:2107.03190v2 source file main.tex.

added_lemmas.statement:
For every well-typed explicit instance \(I\), the procedures \(\mathsf{SC\mbox{-}CTFID}(I)\), \(\mathsf{SATerm}\), and \(\mathsf{Verify}\) terminate.  If \(\mathsf{SC\mbox{-}CTFID}(I)\) returns a verified circuit \(C=N/D\), then for every \(p\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{feas}}\) with \(\mathcal F_+(p)\ne\varnothing\) and every \(\theta\in\mathcal F_+(p)\), one has \(D(p)\ne0\) and
\[
C(p)=\frac{N(p)}{D(p)}=\frac{H(\theta)}{K(\theta)}.
\]
Moreover, \(\operatorname{Eval}\) returns \(\mathsf{infeasible}\) when \(\mathcal F_0(p)=\varnothing\), and returns \(\mathsf{undefined\mbox{-}zero\mbox{-}denominator}\) when \(\mathcal F_0(p)\ne\varnothing\) but \(\mathcal F_+(p)=\varnothing\).  If the algorithm returns a verifier-accepted \((\Gamma,\mathcal M^-,\mathcal M^+)\), then \(\mathcal M^-\) and \(\mathcal M^+\) belong to \(\mathfrak M_{sc}(G,\operatorname{inc},\mathcal X)\), have the declared alphabets and source incidence, agree on every complete law in \(\mathcal R\), have positive query denominators, and have unequal values of \(q\).  These conclusions neither rule out the obstruction output \(O\) nor assert that a circuit is returned whenever the ratio is constant on every positive source-realizable fiber.
added_lemmas.proof_tex:
Termination is the first conclusion of \(\text{thm:explicit-complexity}\).  In detail, its ordinal rank for the structural stack strictly decreases at every outer transition, and each exact algebraic or verification routine consumes a finite ordered worklist.  Thus no structural, terminal, or verification branch can be infinite.

We next prove circuit soundness.  Associate to every pending recursion item its finite source-enumeration polynomial for the active primitive event and maintain the following invariant: on every legal source-mass vector for which each canceled conditioning factor is positive, the expression stored for the item equals that event polynomial.  The invariant holds initially by the decoder definitions of \(\Phi\), \(H\), and \(K\).  Each nonterminal transition preserves it.  A contradictory event has probability zero, deletion of a duplicate assignment leaves the event unchanged, and marginalization over a deleted finite variable is the disjoint finite sum over its states.  Ancestor restriction removes only variables that have already been summed out.  A consolidated-district split is valid because no primitive source crosses two distinct consolidated districts: such a source would induce bidirected adjacency between them; the remaining source blocks are independent by \(\text{def:model-class}\), so their product mass makes the corresponding primitive-event probability factor.  Regime extraction substitutes the matching coordinate of \(\Phi\), which is exactly the supplied complete regime cell.  If a common nonnegative factor \(F\) is canceled from a conditional numerator and denominator, positivity of the original denominator \(FG\) implies \(F>0\), so the cancellation involves no division by zero.  Finally, sums, products, and substitutions of expressions satisfying the invariant preserve equality.

There are two terminal bases.  On an acyclic terminal, \(\text{lem:acyclic-ctfid-soundness}\) identifies the expression returned by \(\mathsf{ctfID}\) with the active counterfactual probability.  On a cyclic terminal, write the candidate as \(N/D\).  By \(\text{def:source-terminal-elimination}\), it is emitted only after exact real quantifier elimination proves that there is no legal \(\vartheta\) with \(K(\vartheta)>0\) satisfying either
\[
D(\Phi(\vartheta))H(\vartheta)-N(\Phi(\vartheta))K(\vartheta)\ne0
\quad\text{or}\quad
D(\Phi(\vartheta))=0.
\]
Hence, for every such \(\vartheta\),
\[
D(\Phi(\vartheta))\ne0,
\qquad
D(\Phi(\vartheta))H(\vartheta)=N(\Phi(\vartheta))K(\vartheta).
\]
Backward induction along the finite recursion trace gives these identities for the composed global expression.  If \(p\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{feas}}\) and \(\theta\in\mathcal F_+(p)\), then \(\Phi(\theta)=p\) and \(K(\theta)>0\) by \(\text{def:source-fiber}\).  Substitution and division by the two verified nonzero quantities give
\[
D(p)\ne0,
\qquad
\frac{N(p)}{D(p)}=\frac{H(\theta)}{K(\theta)}.
\]
This is a one-way soundness statement; no step shows that componentwise fiber constancy forces the terminal to find such an \(N/D\).

The two evaluation statuses are immediate from the ordered exact tests in \(\text{def:evaluation-semantics}\).  The first status is returned exactly after proving \(\mathcal F_0(p)=\varnothing\).  Conditional on nonemptiness of that fiber, the second is returned exactly after proving \(\mathcal F_+(p)=\varnothing\).  No circuit divisor is evaluated on either branch.

Finally suppose \(\mathsf{Verify}\) accepts \((\Gamma,\mathcal M^-,\mathcal M^+)\).  By \(\text{def:certificate-verifier}\), all source-simplex signs and algebraic coordinates are checked exactly, the named source blocks remain separate, every positive-mass decoded tuple is legal, and subset unique solvability is rechecked.  Therefore both decoded models have the same alphabets and incidence and lie in \(\mathfrak M_{sc}(G,\operatorname{inc},\mathcal X)\).  The verifier also establishes
\[
\Phi(\theta^-)=\Phi(\theta^+)=p^*,
\qquad
K(\theta^-)K(\theta^+)>0,
\qquad
\Delta_q=H(\theta^-)K(\theta^+)-H(\theta^+)K(\theta^-)\ne0,
\]
and checks every complete boundary-interface row.  The first equality gives equality of every complete supplied regime cell at the reached terminal.  Replaying the trace and applying \(\text{lem:boundary-interface-gluing}\) at each stored interface preserves all these cell equalities in the decoded global models; hence the two complete laws agree for every \(r\in\mathcal R\).  Since \(K\) is a probability, the strict product inequality implies \(K(\theta^-)>0\) and \(K(\theta^+)>0\).  Thus both conditional targets are defined and
\[
q(\mathcal M^-)-q(\mathcal M^+)
=\frac{H(\theta^-)}{K(\theta^-)}-\frac{H(\theta^+)}{K(\theta^+)}
=\frac{\Delta_q}{K(\theta^-)K(\theta^+)}\ne0.
\]
This proves verifier soundness without asserting that every locally satisfiable separator necessarily has the transmitting interface needed to produce such an accepted global certificate.
added_lemmas.justification: This theorem records the closed operational guarantees without mislabeling them as the unresolved formula-or-countermodel completeness direction.
added_lemmas.gap: The acyclic base has a complete published algorithm, but cyclic source-factorized terminals require separate verification of legality, source labels, boundary rows, and exact algebraic outputs.
added_lemmas.consumer: The package may safely evaluate every returned circuit and replay every returned negative certificate even before the terminal completeness question is settled.

proposed.statement: Fix \(0<\alpha<1\) and a finite vector \(Q=(C_1(p),\ldots,C_d(p))\) returned by \(\mathsf{SC\mbox{-}CTFID}\).  Then \(\sqrt n(\widehat Q-Q)=n^{-1/2}\sum_{r,i}\varphi_r(X_{ri})+o_P(1)\) and converges to \(N(0,\Sigma_Q)\), possibly singular, and the plug-in covariance is consistent.  Let \(I_0=\{j:\Sigma_{Q,jj}>0\}\).  Under the thresholded definition of \(\mathcal C_{1-\alpha}\), \(P(\widehat I_+=I_0)\to1\); if \(I_0\ne\varnothing\), the Gaussian max-statistic region has limiting simultaneous coverage \(1-\alpha\) on \(I_0\).  Symbolically constant coordinates are exact equalities, and every other coordinate with zero first-order variance is reported as degenerate rather than studentized.
proposed.justification: Symbolic identification becomes statistically usable when its multi-regime derivatives and degenerate cells are handled automatically.
proposed.gap: LiLuedtke2023 derives influence functions for prespecified smooth data-fusion targets, while Tikka2023 returns symbolic acyclic counterfactual formulas without an inference compiler.
proposed.consumer: The cfid package can return estimates, influence functions, joint covariance, and simultaneous regions beside every verified regular circuit.

proposed_core_edits.reason: The statistical result uses the proved one-way validity of returned circuits, not the still-open converse asserting that the algorithm always returns a circuit or same-class countermodel.  Replacing that dependency prevents the proved inference theorem from inheriting an unnecessary open premise.

open_obligations.what_is_open: Two implications remain.  First, on every legal sparse-source terminal and across all of its positive components, constancy of \(H/K\) on each fiber of \(\Phi\) must yield one representative \(N(p)/D(p)\in\mathbb Q(p)\) whose divisor is nonzero on the entire positive feasible image, thereby excluding \(O\).  Second, every satisfiable source-preserving two-copy separator must admit a boundary assignment with nonzero exterior transmission through every stored recursive interface, so that the glued same-alphabet, same-source-incidence models still disagree on \(q\).
open_obligations.obstruction: Positive-real fiber constancy does not by itself imply rational descent: for a general polynomial map, \(p=t^2\) on \(t>0\) makes \(H=t\), \(K=1\) constant on every positive fiber while the descended value is \(\sqrt p\), not an element of \(\mathbb Q(p)\).  The frozen source-polynomial structure may rule out this phenomenon, but no proof establishes that exclusion, patches all comprehensive components, or produces a globally nonvanishing divisor.  Separately, the boundary gluing lemma is conditional on a transmitting assignment; the present recursion invariant does not preclude every exterior transmission factor from vanishing for a locally separating pair.
open_obligations.attempted: Componentwise comprehensive elimination and exact function-field membership close every terminal where rational membership and cross-component agreement can be verified.  Exact descent was obtained for the latent-path product terminal and for the unrestricted binary two-cycle.  The primitive-event gluing identity and a two-district transmitter close specific interfaces, while the CHSH witness correctly rejects unrestricted legal-table gluing.  These arguments establish neither rational closure for every legal product-simplex image nor a universal noncancellation invariant for all recursion states.
open_obligations.partial_result: Termination and both output-soundness directions are proved in \(\text{thm:sc-ctfid-output-soundness}\).  Every emitted circuit has a divisor nonzero on the full positive feasible image and equals \(H(\theta)/K(\theta)\) on every \(\theta\in\mathcal F_+(p)\); the evaluation statuses are exact.  Every accepted negative certificate decodes two same-alphabet models in \(\mathfrak M_{sc}(G,\operatorname{inc},\mathcal X)\) with separate named source blocks, identical supplied complete laws, positive denominators, and unequal conditional targets.  At a terminal, exact two-copy elimination decides whether a local separator exists.  If it does, it supplies algebraic source masses with equal menu and boundary-interface polynomials and nonzero local target cross-product.  If it does not, the ratio is set-theoretically constant on each positive real fiber; whenever componentwise function-field membership and cross-component agreement succeed, the terminal constructs and universally verifies a rational representative.  The established boundary-interface lemma transmits a separator whenever a nonzero transmitting boundary assignment is present.  What is not proved is that these two conditional successes occur at every legal sparse-source terminal and every recursive interface.

prose_updates.tldr: Finite-alphabet simple SCMs make feedback counterfactuals well defined, but the cyclic formula-or-countermodel completeness step remains open.  \(\mathsf{SC\mbox{-}CTFID}\) is a deterministic cycle-label- and source-incidence-preserving recursion on explicit legal response tables.  The proved operational theorem gives termination, exact evaluation statuses, valid rational formulas whenever a verified circuit is emitted, and valid same-alphabet same-source-incidence countermodels whenever a certificate is emitted and accepted.  The unresolved converse has exactly two parts: rational descent on every legal positive source fiber and nonvanishing transmission of every local separator through all recursive boundary interfaces.  Returned regular circuits nevertheless compile to proved multinomial influence functions and threshold-valid simultaneous Gaussian regions, with exact symbolic constants and first-order degenerate coordinates reported separately.

project_justification.gap: CorreaLeeBareinboim2021 proves complete conditional counterfactual identification for recursive SCMs, while BongersForrePetersMooij2021 supplies cyclic simple-SCM semantics and ForreMooij2020 proves sound cyclic interventional identification.  None proves source-aware rational descent and universal same-class countermodel transmission for cyclic Layer-3 queries.
project_justification.niche: One induced chordless cycle per consolidated district permits nontrivial feedback and sparse confounding while admitting exact legality enumeration, preserved cycle labels, and finite source-polynomial elimination.
project_justification.fill: SC-CTFID combines conditional counterfactual cancellation with an ordered cyclic recursion, explicit source-aware real and Groebner elimination, exact certificate replay, and boundary-interface bookkeeping.  The current result proves termination and the soundness of every verified positive or negative output, isolates the two missing implications needed for completeness, and supplies automatic fixed-dimensional inference for every returned regular circuit.

sampling_model.overlap: Evaluation separates infeasible menu vectors from feasible vectors having no positive-denominator model.  Inference assumes positive limiting regime fractions and a fixed positive margin for every circuit divisor.  Its variance threshold satisfies \(\kappa_n\to0\) and \(\delta_n/\kappa_n\to0\); the proof establishes the simultaneous matrix rate \(\lVert\widehat\Sigma_Q-\Sigma_Q\rVert=O_P(\delta_n)=o_P(\kappa_n)\).
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: No infinite-dimensional nuisance is estimated.  Empirical multinomial cells pass through a verified rational circuit by automatic differentiation; symbolically constant coordinates are exact, and nonsymbolic zero first-order variance coordinates are reported without Wald studentization.

prose_updates.related_work: CorreaLeeBareinboim2021, Theorems 5--6, supplies the complete acyclic CTFID base and conditional cancellation.  BongersForrePetersMooij2021 supplies simple-SCM solvability and intervention semantics, while ForreMooij2020 gives sound cyclic interventional identification but not Layer-3 completeness.  ZhangTianBareinboim2022 informs finite response parametrization, and NavascuesWolfe2020 together with WolfeSpekkensFritz2019 shows why independent latent sources impose compatibility restrictions beyond unrestricted legal response-table mixtures.  LeeSpekkens2017 demonstrates exact algebraic recovery only in selected small structures.  Those results support the verified terminal operations but do not establish the two still-open steps here: one rational representative on every positive sparse-source image and universal source-preserving boundary transmission.  LiLuedtke2023 informs the multi-regime influence-function calculation, while Tikka2023 identifies cfid as the direct software consumer.
prose_updates.technical_internal_limitation: The explicit response and source tables may already be exponentially larger than the graph, and no succinct-input efficiency claim is made.  More importantly, completeness is not yet proved: the obstruction \(O\) has not been excluded on every legal sparse-source positive fiber, and a locally nonzero separator has not been shown to retain a nonzero target contrast through every exterior interface.  The inference theorem is fixed-dimensional and pointwise on positive-margin strata; nonsymbolic zero first-order variance coordinates are deliberately reported without a Wald interval.
prose_updates.honest_scope: The established claims are exact cycle legality, source-preserving finite compression in the frozen core, selected source-realizability calculations, intervention closure, conditional boundary gluing when a transmitting assignment is supplied, termination, one-way circuit soundness, verifier soundness of accepted negative certificates, exact evaluation statuses, and regular multinomial circuit inference.  Computational enumeration remains evidence rather than a general proof.  The headline formula-or-same-class-countermodel equivalence remains open until rational descent is proved for every legal positive source fiber and every satisfiable local separator is shown to possess a nonvanishing recursive transmission.  A legal terminal producing a genuinely algebraic nonrational identified value, or a local separator annihilated by every exterior interface, would refute the current completeness contract.

statement_notes.justification: This is the desired cyclic formula-or-verifiable-same-class-countermodel theorem, but it remains open at rational descent and universal boundary transmission; the closed termination and output-validity claims are stated separately.
statement_notes.gap: Acyclic CTFID completeness does not imply that a positive-real sparse-source fiber-constant ratio descends to one rational circuit, nor that every local cyclic separator survives arbitrary stored exterior interfaces.
statement_notes.consumer: cfid obtains safe formula and certificate feedback from the proved output-soundness theorem, while unconditional formula-or-certificate completeness awaits the two isolated obligations.

statement_notes.justification: For every returned regular circuit, automatic differentiation now yields a proved multi-regime influence function, singular covariance limit, consistent covariance estimate, and valid thresholded simultaneous region.
statement_notes.gap: The proof supplies the previously implicit threshold requirement by deriving \(O_P(\delta_n)=o_P(\kappa_n)\) matrix error from multinomial sampling and the circuit margin.
statement_notes.consumer: cfid can report estimates, influence functions, joint covariance, simultaneous intervals for positive-variance coordinates, exact symbolic cells, and separate first-order-degeneracy statuses.
